title: Booking Side Notes
user: A small appointment business that needs to keep operational notes—call back, access detail, follow-up, supplier delay—visible beside a booking without falsely blocking another appointment slot.
smallest_useful_product: Local companion PWA that imports a day’s ICS events and attaches nonblocking, time-anchored notes, checkboxes, and reminder status; print or export a daily brief.
success_measure: In a four-week pilot, users record 90% of operational notes in the companion and no note creates an accidental unavailable booking slot.
constraints: ICS files and notes can contain client PII; default to local storage, minimize event fields, and avoid background sync without opt-in.
